book.title: 1934: Caught in the Crossroads
book.tagline: A relic from the Crusades resurfaces, threatening a world on the edge.
description: Europe’s scars from the Great War were supposed to be healing. However, the gears of history are already moving forward.

An archaeological excavation in Yugoslavia uncovers a clue to a lost fragment of the True Cross, missing since the Crusades. When Nazi operatives steal the discovery, four unlikely allies are drawn into the search: a war veteran, his actress sister, a disillusioned archaeologist, and a German scholar cast out by the new regime.

They trail the artifact across a continent shifting beneath their feet. But they are not alone. A German officer who sees the relic as more than an artifact, but as a tool to shape belief to shape the future. As tensions rise and their paths begin to converge, the search becomes a race not only to uncover the past but to determine what it means. Once the past is controlled, there may be no stopping what follows.
Not a story of lone heroes, but of ordinary people caught in forces larger than themselves—and forced to decide what can still be preserved before the world crosses a point of no return.
